title: au-a4-cooling-off
script: Signed on a private sale? Your report the same day we inspect, or your money back. In Victoria, most private sales give you three business days to cool off. You can't wait a week for a report. Melbourne buyers rate us four point nine on Google. We check the building and timber pests, and photograph every defect. So before your cooling-off ends, you know whether to proceed, renegotiate, or walk. Tap below.
